THE BRAND · 60 SECONDS
BEFORE SOLIS

The problem wasn't effort.
It was chaos.

Naming chaos, skewed data

Every file named differently — so the data built on those names couldn't be trusted.

Creative, lost

Elements filed away and forgotten in Google Drive — made once, found never.

Briefing what already exists

No view of what's actively available — so time went into re-making it.

Journeys out of sync

Aligned user journeys were hard when no one could see each other's creative.

Sign-off blind spots

No reliable way to know what was and wasn't approved to use.

Filenames, not visuals

Our only reference was a name — no granular read on what's trending, or why.

WHY SOLIS

“Of the sun.”
Everything orbits one source.

All creative lives in one place — every brand, every department.
One unified file-naming convention, built to scale with us.
If it isn't on Solis, it doesn't exist.
THE NAMING CONVENTION

The file name is the system.

BRANDVARIABLE_ GEOVARIABLE_ VERTICALVARIABLE_ JNXXXXJOB NUMBER_ DESCRIPTORVARIABLE_ VARIATIONVARIABLE_ CHANNELVARIABLE_ DIMENSIONVARIABLE_ FILETYPEMOTION OR STATIC_ CREATIVE_SKUVARIABLE_ + YOURSOPTIONAL ADD-ON

Never delete a variable. Ever.

Every variable ties the asset to its tags, reporting and the league table. Remove one and the chain breaks silently.

Adding is fine.

Need extra tracking or reporting? Append what you need to the end — the convention is built to scale.
